Nermin Sefić — author of Parameters and analyses: the 64 parameters SPT measures — and what they show
Live risk alert — When ACWR crosses the threshold, the dashboard raises a red alert with the reason and a substitution recommendation.
SPT AI analytics: profile radar, weekly load with flags, an ACWR gauge and a heatmap — illustration
SPT Pod sensor — GNSS 20 Hz (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou), 9-axis IMU up to 1000 Hz, UWB and BLE in an IP67 housing. It switches from GPS to UWB automatically when play moves ind
Sideline tablet — The coach on the touchline has the same data as the analyst: who is dropping in intensity, who is in the red heart-rate zone.
Control room — Up to 12 live tiles; each shows what you choose — the map, heart rate, speeds, alerts or a two-player comparison.
Live dashboard — Positions of every player 20 times per second, score, speeds and load — for the bench and the analyst, with no delay.
SPT Edge One — A stadium server receives every sensor, calculates metrics locally and sends them to the bench in under a second — even when the internet fails.
Indoor sports with UWB — UWB anchors on the ceiling deliver centimetre-level positions where GPS cannot work.
Athlete app — Readiness every morning, sleep, resting heart rate and weekly load — the athlete understands their day.
SPT Cloud for partners — The servers, tools and software that also power other manufacturers' devices.
Amateur athletes — Watch and app: heart rate, sleep and readiness for anyone who trains — from a morning run to a marathon.
SPT scale — Bioimpedance: weight, muscle, fat, water, visceral fat and basal metabolic rate — straight into the athlete record and the meal planner.
Chest strap — Beat-by-beat heart rate for interval training, water polo and rowing — where an optical wrist sensor gets it wrong.
Training with SPT vests — Sprint drills with speed, acceleration and load measured for every player.
UWB anchors — Anchors on the arena ceiling deliver position with roughly ±10 cm accuracy where GPS cannot work: volleyball, basketball, handball, futsal, hockey.
Pocket between the shoulder blades — The sensor sits between the shoulder blades — the steadiest point of the body while running, with the best view of the sky for satellite signal
SPT vest — A body-fitted compression vest; the sensor stays still against the back, so the GPS trace and accelerations are clean. Washable, breathable, sizes from youth categories

Nermin Sefić — autor teksta Parametri i analize: 64 parametra koje SPT mjeri — i što pokazuju
Alarm rizika uživo — Kad ACWR prijeđe prag, ploča diže crveno upozorenje s razlogom i preporukom za izmjenu.
SPT AI analitika: radar profila, tjedno opterećenje sa zastavicama, ACWR mjerač i toplinska karta — ilustracija
SPT Pod senzor — GNSS 20 Hz (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou), 9-osni IMU do 1000 Hz, UWB i BLE u kućištu IP67. Sam prelazi s GPS-a na UWB kad igra uđe u dvoranu.
Tablet uz aut-liniju — Trener na terenu ima iste podatke kao analitičar: tko pada u intenzitetu, tko je u crvenoj zoni pulsa.
Kontrolna soba — Do 12 live pločica; svaka prikazuje ono što odaberete — kartu, puls, brzine, alarme ili usporedbu dvaju igrača.
Live nadzorna ploča — Pozicije svih igrača 20 puta u sekundi, rezultat, brzine i opterećenje — za klupu i analitičara, bez kašnjenja.
SPT Edge One — Stadionski server prima sve senzore, računa metrike lokalno i šalje ih na klupu za manje od sekunde — i kad internet zakaže.
Dvoranski sportovi s UWB-om — UWB sidra na stropu daju centimetarsku poziciju ondje gdje GPS ne radi.
Aplikacija za sportaša — Spremnost svako jutro, san, puls u mirovanju i opterećenje tjedna — sportaš razumije svoj dan.
SPT Cloud za partnere — Serveri, alati i softver na kojima rade i uređaji drugih proizvođača.
Rekreativci — Sat i aplikacija: puls, san i spremnost za svakoga tko trenira — od jutarnjeg trčanja do maratona.
SPT vaga — Bioimpedancija: masa, mišići, masnoća, voda, visceralna mast i bazalni metabolizam — izravno u karton i planer prehrane.
Prsni pojas — Puls otkucaj po otkucaj za intervalne treninge, vaterpolo i veslanje — ondje gdje optički senzor na zapešću griješi.
Trening s SPT prslucima — Sprint-vježbe uz mjerenje brzine, ubrzanja i opterećenja svakog igrača.
UWB sidra — Sidra na stropu dvorane daju poziciju s preciznošću oko ±10 cm ondje gdje GPS ne radi: odbojka, košarka, rukomet, futsal, hokej.
Džep između lopatica — Senzor sjedi između lopatica — najmirnija točka tijela pri trčanju, s najboljim pogledom na nebo za satelitski signal.
SPT prsluk — Kompresijski prsluk prilagođen tijelu; senzor miruje uz leđa pa su GPS trag i ubrzanja čisti. Perivo, prozračno, veličine od mlađih kategorija naviše.
SPT sat — Puls, HRV, san i dnevni oporavak; vibracija upozorava sportaša kad izađe iz zadane zone. Rekreativcu je sat sam po sebi cijeli SPT.
